measurementPolicy.compile: Pure complete v4 compiler over the full frozen input; source generation and model/network time reported separately.
measurementPolicy.coldIndex: Fresh browser context/process with no in-memory query/index cache; verify bytes from the exported world package before opening the query evaluator. Import/setup time reported separately and never silently removed from a measured interval.
measurementPolicy.warmQuery: Actual registered provider/query path over the same immutable package identity; alternate early and late needles and verify exact evidence.
measurementPolicy.memory: Record the method, baseline and target browser process tree; a before/after heap difference alone is not peak memory evidence.
measurementPolicy.failures: Keep all attempts and errors. Do not change targets or relabel unavailable/insufficient as successful retrieval.
measurementPolicy.content: Report unique source field and distinct text counts, raw Unicode count, exact duplicate text characters, frozen package bytes, record/edge counts and source fingerprints. Synthetic varied scenes are not a long novel quality benchmark.
